say:0:1831514001:1.text: There's no doubt about it. It's tempting you.

say:0:1831514001:1.female: There's no doubt about it. It's tempting you.

say:1:1831514002:1.text: There's that potion that can restore a living creature's memories.
say:1:1831514002:1.source_cn: 没错，就是那瓶能让生灵蛹恢复记忆的药剂。它在诱惑你。
say:1:1831514002:1.male: There's that potion that can restore a living creature's memories.

say:2:1831514003:1.text: The potions belong to Tephesia, and Tephesia is the Seventh Seat of the Arcane Council—technically your subordinate. So taking one bottle wouldn't be such a big deal, right?

say:5:1831514006:1.text: Vitality essence. A substance refined from a truly horrifying species of insect. To make matters worse, it bears an extra prefix on this recipe: Millennial Cockroach Recovery Base Liquid.

say:9:1831514009:1.text: Picturing what this potion looked like before it was brewed, you silently place it back where you found it.
say:9:1831514009:1.source_cn: 你在脑海中回忆了一下这瓶药剂“生前”的模样，然后默默地...

say:10:1831514010:1.text: If recovering your memories means drinking this stuff and turning your stomach into a whole insect zoo, you'd rather stay amnesiac forever.
say:10:1831514010:1.source_cn: 如果找回记忆的代价是喝下它，让千奇百怪的虫子在你的肚子...
say:10:1831514010:1.male: If recovering your memories means drinking this stuff and turning your stomach into a whole insect zoo, you'd rather stay amnesiac forever.
say:10:1831514010:1.female: If recovering your memories means drinking this stuff and turning your stomach into a whole insect zoo, you'd rather stay amnesiac forever.

say:12:1831514011:1.text: Alright then! A true hero never shies away from medicine, even if it's made of bugs!
say:12:1831514011:1.source_cn: 好吧，真正的勇士从不畏惧喝药，即使它是虫子制成的！
say:12:1831514011:1.male: Alright then! A true hero never shies away from medicine, even if it's made of bugs!
say:12:1831514011:1.female: Alright then! A true hero never shies away from medicine, even if it's made of bugs!

say:13:1831514012:1.text: Pinching your nose and shutting your eyes tight, you gulp the whole potion down in one go...
say:13:1831514012:1.source_cn: 你捏住鼻子，紧闭双眼，一口气将药剂灌入了口中……
say:13:1831514012:1.male: Pinching your nose and shutting your eyes tight, you gulp the whole potion down in one go...
say:13:1831514012:1.female: Pinching your nose and shutting your eyes tight, you gulp the whole potion down in one go...

say:14:1831514013:1.text: A bizarre, vile flavor floods your mouth, as if a slimy, tentacled monster from the deep sea just gave your tongue an intense, uninvited massage, followed by a swift slap to the face.
say:14:1831514013:1.source_cn: 你嘴里充斥着诡异古怪的味道，像是某种不可名状的深海生物...
say:14:1831514013:1.male: A bizarre, vile flavor floods your mouth, as if a slimy, tentacled monster from the deep sea just gave your tongue an intense, uninvited massage, followed by a swift slap to the face.
say:14:1831514013:1.female: A bizarre, vile flavor floods your mouth, as if a slimy, tentacled monster from the deep sea just gave your tongue an intense, uninvited massage, followed by a swift slap to the face.

say:15:1831514014:1.text: Somehow, you survive the torture without passing out. You could almost weep with pride at your own sheer resilience.
say:15:1831514014:1.source_cn: 面对这样的酷刑，你居然没有晕倒。你简直要为自己的坚强而落泪。
say:15:1831514014:1.male: Somehow, you survive the torture without passing out. You could almost weep with pride at your own sheer resilience.
say:15:1831514014:1.female: Somehow, you survive the torture without passing out. You could almost weep with pride at your own sheer resilience.

say:16:1831514015:1.text: Unfortunately, no memories surface. Then again, you probably never had the chance to taste anything this vile before you lost your memory.
say:16:1831514015:1.source_cn: 遗憾的是，你的脑海中并没有浮现任何记忆。想来也是，失忆...
say:16:1831514015:1.male: Unfortunately, no memories surface. Then again, you probably never had the chance to taste anything this vile before you lost your memory.
say:16:1831514015:1.female: Unfortunately, no memories surface. Then again, you probably never had the chance to taste anything this vile before you lost your memory.

say:17:1831514016:1.text: But you're certain of one thing: Even if you lost your memory ten thousand more times, you'd never forget the taste of this potion.
say:17:1831514016:1.source_cn: 但你确信，即使再失忆一万次，你也绝不可能忘记这瓶药剂的味道。
say:17:1831514016:1.male: But you're certain of one thing: Even if you lost your memory ten thousand more times, you'd never forget the taste of this potion.
